en: Great is the Lord God Almighty and greatly to be praised His understanding is infinite His love endures forevermore
He Heals the lonely brokenhearted and gently binds up all their wounds Counts the number of the stars in space and Gives the names to all of them
Covers the heavens with clouds and Provides rain for the earth He Makes grass grow, and Gives the beast its food
O Jerusalem Praise the Lord Praise your God and King with songs of honor
Come before the Lord with shouts of thanksgiving In God’s presence worship Him
